Only 3/8 checkpoints are fully met (Shape, Contrast, Material). The deviation from standard colors (yellow/red vs green/blue) is a minor alignment issue, but the lack of readable text is a major functional failure for this class.

Structural artifacts include ambiguous connections between signs and the pole (Severity 3), where brackets are missing/fused. Minor perspective warping (Severity 2) and slight compression noise (Severity 0.2) are present but secondary. The high topology mask confidence indicates the objects are distinct from the background, but does not negate the internal structural/semantic defects.
